effect_description_eng:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Takato Matsuki] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, you may delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] When this Digimon with [Gallantmon] in its name would leave the battle area other than by your effects, you may play 1 each of [Takato Matsuki] and [Guilmon] from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Growlmon] in name or w/[Hero] trait: Cost 3
